title: The Akedah (העקדה): The Binding of Isaac, Part 1 — title slide
summary: Opening title slide of the series on the Akedah, the Binding of Isaac (Genesis 22), shown over a video still of the presenter seated in front of a world map beside a toy ram and a leafy branch.

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter, a man in glasses and a white T-shirt, seated in front of a large colourful world map, holding a leafy green branch; beside him on the left sits a stuffed toy ram with curled horns tangled in green leaves, and orange bird-of-paradise flowers are at the right.
pictures.text_in_picture: The Akedah העקדה The Binding of Isaac Part 1
